name: La Grande Cascade
note: batch4/bois.ts: Alphand's 1856 rock and fall, its foot at the east shore of OSM's pool (48.86352 2.24086), facing it. Nonbuilding.

name: La Petite Cascade
note: batch4/bois.ts: the Lac Supérieur's overflow into the Lac Inférieur's south tip, read off the aerial.

name: Le Chalet des Îles
note: batch4/bois.ts: the Swiss chalet of 1867 on the northern island. Long ridge at bearing 40 on the aerial.

name: Le Kiosque de l'Empereur
note: batch4/bois.ts: Davioud's small pavilion on the southern island. OSM has no node for it: the clearing on the aerial.

name: Lac Daumesnil: le Temple et la Grotte
note: batch4/bois.ts: OSM's Temple Grec (way/439501438), above its Grotte de la Gloriette (node/11928201569), on the fringe past the box: seen across the lake.

name: Le Grand Rocher de Vincennes
note: batch4/bois.ts: 65 m of the zoo's concrete rock, on OSM's Grand Rocher (way/262416016, 77 × 89 m, 60 m, and what the bake made of its base). On the fringe; a skyline thing, for the Porte Dorée and the lake. In for the Parc Floral, off the map.

name: La Tour aux Figures
note: batch4/bois.ts: Dubuffet, 24 m, the Parc de l'Île Saint-Germain. A stand-in; on the Tripo list.

name: Le Château Rothschild
note: batch4/bois.ts: Armand's château, its four pavilions off OSM's outline, under the long pale protective roof the aerial has. OSM's 28 m is wrong.

name: Parc Edmond-de-Rothschild: the lake's rocks
note: batch4/bois.ts: the Baron's rockwork at the lake's head.

name: Le Pré Catelan: the pavilion in the wood
note: 21 × 24 m in the park at (570, 325) on g-catelan, a low glazed roof on the aerial: OSM's 7 levels and 28 m are wrong.

name: L'Hôtel de Cluny
note: batch4/cluny.ts: the abbots' Flamboyant hôtel, its court, its street wall: on OSM's way/1132441556 (48 × 43 m, the corps de logis and wings) and the west wing's parts. Local +x along the corps de logis.

name: Musée de Cluny: the halls
note: The museum's halls between the hôtel and the Thermes. OSM has them 28 m and 7 levels (2026-10-31, from the Boulevard Saint-Michel: a Haussmann block): the aerial's slate and glass low roofs. (The way/41874779 entry in museums.json took the outline's parts; it now names only the part it means to.)

name: Musée de Cluny: the red-tiled hall
note: The red roof on the aerial, over the Frigidarium's neighbour: it had 32 m and 7 levels from OSM.

name: Palais de Tokyo: the west wing
note: batch4/tokyo-wings.ts: the whole of OSM's outline as one wing, in place of its 22 parts at 12 to 32 m.

name: Musée d'Art Moderne de Paris: the east wing
note: batch4/tokyo-wings.ts: the whole of OSM's outline as one wing, and the dozen ways at 28 and 32 m that stood through it. Red brick from the road until now.

name: Musée Cernuschi
note: batch4/hotels.ts: the banker's hôtel on the Avenue Vélasquez at the Parc Monceau's gate.

name: Musée Nissim-de-Camondo
note: batch4/hotels.ts: Sergent's Trianon, the gate on the Rue de Monceau and the salon's bay to the park.

name: La Maison de Balzac
note: batch4/hotels.ts

name: Le Musée de la Vie romantique
note: batch4/hotels.ts: Scheffer's ochre house at the end of its lane.

name: Le Musée Gustave-Moreau
note: batch4/hotels.ts: two floors of studio windows over a town house.

name: Le Musée Bourdelle
note: batch4/hotels.ts

name: Le Musée Zadkine
note: batch4/hotels.ts: hidden down its lane behind the Rue d'Assas.

name: Maisons La Roche et Jeanneret
note: batch4/hotels.ts: Le Corbusier, 1925, white paint and ribbon windows. Replaces the bake's way/85224488 and way/85224477.
